svg.title: Earliest start, critical path and slack
svg.desc: The ADG of the previous figure with durations; each vertex shows its earliest start S and completion C; the critical path is highlighted; a delay on a slack action does not move the end.

g.text: S(v) = max over predecessors u of C(u); C(v) = S(v) + d(v).

text.font-family: 'IBM Plex Sans', 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

g.text: Makespan = max C = 10. A delay on a critical action delays the

text.font-family: 'IBM Plex Sans', 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

g.text: end by the same amount. A delay on AGV-3's action is absorbed

text.font-family: 'IBM Plex Sans', 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

g.text: up to its slack (1); beyond that, AGV-1's second action starts late

g.text: Durations are made up for the example; S, C and slack are computed by the figure script with the recurrence shown.

text.font-family: 'IBM Plex Sans', 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

g.text: Timing on an ADG: earliest start, critical path, slack

text.font-family: 'IBM Plex Sans', 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

g.text: Given durations, the earliest each action can start is the latest completion of its predecessors. The longest path fixes the makespan; everything off it has slack.
